title: TC-HALF: lower classical storage through constant-width collimation

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and every fixed s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the single TC-HALF algorithm/configuration in proof.md Section1, with R0=max(ceil(sqrt(n)/2),2v+2), recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than0.99 under independent ideal source copies. The same configuration has total charged sequential work T = O(n^(8) 2^((5/2) sqrt(n))) on EVERY execution branch, jointly with the other three resource claims and clean-source tolerance. All failed merges, rejected copies, retries, addressing, controller work, caps and cleanup are charged. The exact growth index of this declared envelope is 1/2.

For every N>=2 and every fixed s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the single TC-HALF algorithm/configuration in proof.md Section1, with R0=max(ceil(sqrt(n)/2),2v+2), recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than0.99 under independent ideal source copies. The same configuration has peak classical bits S_C = O(n^(3/2) 2^((1/2) sqrt(n))) on EVERY execution branch, jointly with the other three resource claims and clean-source tolerance. All failed merges, rejected copies, retries, addressing, controller work, caps and cleanup are charged. The exact growth index of this declared envelope is 1/2.

For every N>=2 and every fixed s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the single TC-HALF algorithm/configuration in proof.md Section1, with R0=max(ceil(sqrt(n)/2),2v+2), recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than0.99 under independent ideal source copies. The same configuration has peak accessible qubits S_Q = O(n^(1)) on EVERY execution branch, jointly with the other three resource claims and clean-source tolerance. All failed merges, rejected copies, retries, addressing, controller work, caps and cleanup are charged. The exact growth index of this declared envelope is 0.

For every N>=2 and every fixed s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the single TC-HALF algorithm/configuration in proof.md Section1, with R0=max(ceil(sqrt(n)/2),2v+2), recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than0.99 under independent ideal source copies. The same configuration has all acquired copies Q = O(n^(4) 2^((2) sqrt(n))) on EVERY execution branch, jointly with the other three resource claims and clean-source tolerance. All failed merges, rejected copies, retries, addressing, controller work, caps and cleanup are charged. The exact growth index of this declared envelope is 1/2.

For every N>=2 and every fixed s modulo N, the same TC-HALF algorithm and configuration in proof.md has guaranteed malformed-copy fraction epsilon(n)=0 for n=ceil(log2 N)>=1. Every acquired copy must be an independent ideal coset state rho_s for the same s. Under this promise it recovers the full secret with unconditional probability greater than0.99 jointly with all four worst-case resource bounds. No positive tolerance or maximum-tolerance assertion is made.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
